changeSet.author: MRBLARE
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE users ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), email VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL UNIQUE, password VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, firstname VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, lastname VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() );
changeSet.comment: Create table users with unique email

changeSet.author: MRBLARE
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE roles ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id UUID NOT NULL, role_name VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_roles_user_id FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
CREATE INDEX idx_roles_user_id ON roles (user_id);

changeSet.author: MRBLARE
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN password TYPE VARCHAR(100);
changeSet.comment: Extend password field length for BCrypt hashing
